title: Nuclear & Radiological Survival
license: Public domain — U.S. Government-sponsored report (Oak Ridge National Laboratory, ORNL-5037), published without copyright
publisher: Cresson H. Kearny, Oak Ridge National Laboratory (1979)
attribution: Text from Nuclear War Survival Skills, ORNL-5037 (September 1979), Oak Ridge National Laboratory, from the U.S. Department of Energy OSTI archive. The 1979 original only; later editions contain copyrighted additions. Reformatted into sections; figures not included.
description: Fallout and blast shelters you can build, shelter ventilation and cooling, water and food storage, a homemade fallout meter, light, sanitation and care without doctors. Written in 1979: core physics and shelter methods hold, threat assessments and some medical advice are dated.
